item.title: Which region should the canary run in?
item.body: The canary needs a region before deploy starts. us-east has more traffic; eu-west matches the incident report.

item.title: Keep the legacy export format?
item.body: Two teams still read the legacy CSV export. Dropping it simplifies the writer; keeping it costs one more test suite.

item.title: Which plan owns the shared fixtures?
item.body: The fixtures moved out of every run. Say which plan keeps them so its owner reviews changes to them.

item.title: File the flaky-runner report
item.body: Collect the three runner timeouts from this run and file them with the infrastructure tracker today.
